conclusion: Apollo active-Wonder state supplies a virtual technology-ownership shortcut for supported1..46. A direct admitted generic acquisition can still write a missing raw bit and produce the native first-world flag; this differs from the ordinary science caller, which requires virtual ownership false first. Raw-unowned filtering, source/phase policy, flag lifetime and actual bonus delivery remain necessary before any optional Apollo reward behavior. Repeated raw-owned calls can alter the acquisition tally and are not idempotent.
